name: crm_pipeline
summary: Named pipelines, stage-transition history, and forecast snapshots
description: Pipeline machinery for the CRM: named pipelines that order the existing stage records and can be scoped to a sales team, an append-only stage-transition history that is never overwritten, forecast categories with confidence weights (pipeline, best case, committed), and per-opportunity forecast snapshots. Forecast values are planning estimates and are kept distinct from recognized revenue owned by Accounting.
author: Nexa
